rationale: Fix-up diff (from reviewed_head 91f7d71d3) adds a shared _sanitize_cell helper and routes both _build_csv and _build_xlsx cell + header writes through it. CR-001 resolved: non-primitive cells (dict/list/tuple) are coerced to str and openpyxl-illegal control chars are stripped, so the xlsx path no longer crashes on the inputs the csv path tolerated (tests test_non_primitive_cells_are_stringified, test_illegal_control_chars_stripped, test_native_numeric_cells_preserved pass). CR-002 resolved: leading =,+,-,@,tab,CR on string cells are prefixed with an apostrophe for both formats (tests test_xlsx_neutralizes_formula_injection, test_csv_neutralizes_formula_injection pass). Native numeric/bool cells are preserved (regression guard passes). No new high-risk issue introduced by the fix-up; formula-neutralization of legitimate leading-'-' strings is the accepted standard trade-off, and only string cells are affected (numerics stay numeric). 15/15 export tests and 15/15 toolkit tests green; ruff clean.
